children.value: Model and networks behind the current results
The participant results in this book come from run
(12 October 2026), obtained with the model adopted on 11 October 2026: the agent with the single-stage net allocation and a commitment gain of 3, the 54 summary features of
, and a posterior network and a model classifier each trained on 100,000 simulations. The decision and the validation are documented in
used the networks of 8 June 2026 (commitment gain 8, 40 features); the chapters of that state are kept in

This chapter is the single reference for the symbols used in the modeling chapters, for the prior distribution of every free parameter, and for every constant that is fixed in the simulators. Its purpose is that a reader can reproduce the generative model without collecting bounds and constants from several chapters, and that a change to any of these values has exactly one place in the documentation where it must be recorded.
All values in this chapter were read from the code, namely from
(inference settings), and from the schedule parameters in
. Where a value in another chapter differs from the code, the difference is listed in the last section.
